edit.statement: 'Is the mother of' is not a subproperty of 'is a parent of': being a person's mother does not make someone that person's parent.
edit.subject: mother_of
edit.original: 'Is the mother of' is a subproperty of 'is a parent of': every mother of a person is a parent of that person.
edit.scope: Whether being a person's mother is enough to conclude that one is that person's parent.

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Derived premises are true facts about real people, stated in the prompt. The premises and conclusions are true in the world, so before the edit the conclusion follows from the premise by the subproperty; after it, the conclusion no longer follows from the premise alone. Slot 0025 held a reflexivity edit ('is married to' is reflexive) until 2026-10-22, when reflexivity was dropped as an RBox property: its only instances ask whether a thing is related to itself.
